items.title: Samsung/Google Android XR glasses preorders open
items.notes: Preorders for the Samsung and Google Android XR 'Intelligent Eyewear' (designs with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker) reportedly open 12 Nov. The date comes from Warby Parker's co-CEO on its Q3 earnings call and from Gentle Monster's website; Samsung and Google have not confirmed it. Deliveries have reportedly slipped from November to mid-December. Reports differ on markets: Korean press mentions Korea, the US and other major markets, while Tech Times (citing NewsBytes and GSMArena) says the first rollout covers only the US and South Korea, with Europe, China and Japan excluded. No price announced yet.

items.title: Google I/O 2027 (May, dates not announced)
items.notes: Placeholder on the 1st of the expected month. Google has not announced 2027 dates; the 2026 edition ran 19 to 20 May and its dates were announced in February.

items.title: Apple WWDC 2027 (June, dates not announced)
items.notes: Placeholder on the 1st of the expected month. Apple has not announced 2027 dates; WWDC 2026 ran 8 to 12 June. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported (July 2026) that Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses (N50) at WWDC 2027, with release by end of 2027. Rumour, not confirmed by Apple.
